title: Zesty Snappy Japanese Mixed Berries Takikomi Gohan
description: A Japanese dish featuring frozen mixed berries and umami flavors, with a snappy texture from char-grilled elements, all in a low-fat friendly takikomi-gohan form.
instructions: Rinse the Japanese short grain rice thoroughly and drain well.
In a medium saucepan, combine the rice and 1 3/4 cups of water, then bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, char-grill the diced chicken breast until it is cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, mirin, and sesame oil.
Once the rice is cooked, fluff it with a fork and stir in the frozen mixed berries, grilled chicken, green onions, and the soy sauce mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the Zesty Snappy Japanese Mixed Berries Takikomi Gohan hot.
